rows.title: "A Year of Coping" Conference for Therapists, Marking One Year Since the War Began

content.title: "A Year of Coping" Conference for Therapists, Marking One Year Since the War Began
content.summary: A conference of listening and sharing for therapists, one year into the war. Free of charge, with advance registration.
content.body:
**When?** Sunday, September 29, 2024, 9:00-13:00.

**Where?** Beit Vagan Guest House, 8 HaPisga St., Jerusalem.

**What's on the program?**

- Dr. Danny Brom, founding CEO of Metiv - "War outside and war inside: our place as therapists"
- Facilitated discussion circles
- Sarit Zussman, social activist, artist and educator, mother of the late Ben Zussman, who fell in the Iron Swords war - "Choosing life and insisting on the quality of life"

Participation is free of charge but requires advance registration.
content.location: Beit Vagan Guest House, 8 HaPisga St., Jerusalem
content.price: Free of charge, with advance registration

rows.title: A Roadmap for Trauma-Informed Care - A Joint Conference on Research and Psychotherapy

content.title: A Roadmap for Trauma-Informed Care - A Joint Conference on Research and Psychotherapy
content.summary: A two-day conference for researchers and therapists on trauma research and treatment in the context of Israeli society.
content.body:
The conference took place on February 28 - March 1, 2023, 09:00-17:00, at Herzog Hospital in Jerusalem.

On the first day: TED talks on current trauma research in Israel, parallel sessions on various topics (medicine, society, religion and spirituality) in the context of trauma, and a panel of senior researchers. On the second day: lectures, clinical workshops on trauma therapy, and voices from patients' testimonies.

rows.title: Free Treatment for Veterans Living with Post-Traumatic Stress

content.title: Free Treatment for Veterans Living with Post-Traumatic Stress
content.summary: Metiv has opened a free treatment program for veterans with PTSD as part of a clinical research project.
content.body: Veterans coping with trauma from their military service can contact us to check whether they are suitable for free psychological treatment as part of a research project. According to the English-language page, the clinic operates as part of a clinical study of Somatic Experiencing.
